issues: The strike condition is incorrect: it checks namedFollowerOnFieldByName for Harnessed Flame, but the source requires checking that both Harnessed Flame and Harnessed Glass are in your cemetery. It should be encoded as a cemetery-based condition requiring both names; implement a condition type for named cards in your cemetery (and a way to require both names) and use that to switch between 3 and 7 damage.
The parsed keywords incorrectly include "strike". Strike should not be a keyword here because it is already represented by the ability timing "strike".

The fanfare destroy effect is incorrectly encoded as destroy with targets.count 2 and maxCost 0. It should target up to 2 enemyFieldCard targets without a maxCost restriction, using an optional/up-to targeting form if available.
The parsed keywords incorrectly include "fanfare" and "activated". These are timings represented by abilities, not keywords.
The parsed keywords incorrectly include "evolve". The evolve cost line should be represented by evolvesTo/evolveCost, not as a keyword.

The On Evolve ability is incomplete: it only targets an enemy follower, but the source says "enemy leader or enemy follower". It should be encoded as a damage effect that can target either the enemy leader or an enemy follower; implement a target selector for leader-or-follower choice if the engine lacks one.

The return effect is too narrow: source says "Select a card on your field," but parsed targets only selfFollower. It should be able to target any ally field card; implement/support a target selector for allied field cards including self if needed, then use that with returnToHand.
The parsed keywords incorrectly include "evolve". The evolve cost line should be represented by evolvesTo/evolveCost, not as a keyword.
The On Evolve ability is incomplete: it summons only Steelclad Knight, but it should summon both a Steelclad Knight and a Knight token. Encode this as a sequence with two summon steps.
The parsed keywords incorrectly include "evolve" and "fanfare". Evolve is represented by evolvesTo/evolveCost, and Fanfare is represented by the ability timing, so neither should be in keywords.
The parsed keywords incorrectly include "lastWords". Last Words is represented by the ability timing, not as a keyword.
